title: Projected D-delta-D third-coefficient mixed force-momentum weighted majorant
question: Can the exact A1 partial_q+A0 coefficient from EXP-001073 be controlled by a quartic field weight and an explicit derivative-weighted pointwise majorant without claiming a Q3 orbit bound?
decision_reason: The exact EXP-001073 coefficient is a first-order differential operator with cubic-field coefficient terms. At chi=hbar=c=1, lambda=1/10 and source radius 1/4, coefficient-majorant arithmetic gives |Re A1|<=17/40 A^(3/4), |Im A1|<=9/20 A^(3/4), |Re A0|<=27/160 A^(3/4), and |Im A0|<=17/80 A^(3/4), hence |A1|<=(7/8)A^(3/4) and |A0|<=(61/160)A^(3/4). Primary symbolic, independent Fraction and Lean R256 checks agree on the constants and the 72-point fixture.
method: Reuse the exact A1 and A0 coefficient form from EXP-001073 without introducing a fourth-generator or background hypothesis.
Specialise only the finite coefficient audit to chi=hbar=c=1, lambda=1/10 and |a|<=1/4, expand the four real component polynomials, and sum absolute coefficients with source-radius powers.
Use the quartic weight A=1+q^4+v^4 and the degree-at-most-three monomial rule to turn coefficient sums into all-real A^(3/4) majorants.
Rebuild the bond and q-derivatives in a Fraction-only polynomial dictionary, test the 6x6x2 rational grid, and compile Lean R256 for the exact rational fixtures.
Keep positive-time orbit, modular-domain, history, direct D/delta-D, exhaustion, OS/KMS/GNS, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A gates explicitly open.
finding: For A(q,v)=1+q^4+v^4 and |a|<=1/4, the all-real coefficient majorants are (17/40, 9/20, 27/160, 17/80) for (Re A1, Im A1, Re A0, Im A0). Their conservative complex sums are 7/8 and 61/160. At (3,-2,1/4), (A1,A0)=(-59/40-9i/4,-3/160-59i/80), A=98. The 72-point exact grid reaches component ceilings 59/40, 9/4, 9/80 and 59/80.
